input.artifactRefs: Strict artifact IDs and their known slide IDs
input.renderedEvidenceRefs: Strict PNG evidence IDs, SHA-256 digests, and known slide/artifact refs; no paths, URLs, or binary payloads
input.deterministicFindings: Strict pre-existing deterministic findings with a known slide/artifact ref and optional known rendered-evidence ID

output: Deterministically sorted advisory findings only, each with advisoryStatus=advisory and a stable semantic-audit:v1:<findingId> ID
guarantees: Rejects unknown artifact, slide, rendered-evidence, and deterministic-finding references.
Rejects inconsistent slide/artifact or rendered-evidence references, duplicate IDs, and all extra fields.
Copies no authority or verdict field: advisory output has no fix, ignore, passed, export allow/block, or mutation command.
Produces the same normalized advisory findings for the same valid input.
prohibited: fix, ignore, export allow/block, or any change to AuditReport.passed or export preflight
layout, XML, PPTX, canvas, renderer, or image-generation operations
network, shell, filesystem, model, VLM, MCP, provider, or runtime-pipeline calls
